description: A public database of consumer complaints about financial products and services in the United States. The CFPB page says users can filter, sort and view complaints in the browser and download all published data, which is free of charge for anyone to use; complaints are published only after they are sent to the company and it responds or 15 days pass, and the database generally updates daily. Coverage is the United States, complaints about firms other than small depository institutions referred to other regulators. Caveats: the page says the data are not a statistical sample and a low complaint count does not mean little harm. For simulation it gives dated signals of service failures, such as spikes in complaints about payment or account access problems during outages or after disasters, for validating disruption models. A related catalogue record is the FCC consumer complaints data.
